text_block_list.text: The Kisaragi Sho has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I will definitely win!!

...And so.
Winding time back a little, to right around the start of the New Year.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You want to... practice exchanging
opinions with me?

I had often seen her intentionally hold back her words.
In everyday life, this was never an issue—in fact, it was quite charming.
However—

It felt like something that would become a hurdle in the world of competition.
Above all else...

The Twinkle Series alone takes about three years.
Or even longer, which means spending all that time together.
If we spend that entire time walking on eggshells and letting things slide—
choice_data_list: I'll never be able to reach the "center."

text_block_list.text:
This world surely isn't
such an easy place.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um, actually, I was thinking the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: When I regretted not speaking up during the ekiden, it hit me. I realized... I do this kind of thing pretty often, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
That might have been fine in the past, but the Twinkle Series is different.
So, I really have to change.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If I can change... and grow in a positive way,
the race results will change too, right?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, alright! First off, I'll do my best
to speak my mind freely as we head into the Kisaragi Sho!
The new endeavor kicked off unexpectedly smoothly and full of fighting spirit.
However, the road ahead was not going to be that easy...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Here is this week's training menu, correct!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
...Umm...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...Here and here. Oh, and here too!
I'd like to increase the load a bit more.
And maybe a bit more combat-oriented training too—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Still, my past training data is listed here.
They put this plan together by cross-referencing it.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(I see. It's Trainer, after all.
They've planned this out while covering for the things I didn't even notice, haven't they?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(She must be looking at things from a broad perspective.
If I just blurt out some vague thought off the top of my head, I'll only trouble her...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (...Could I... become... maybe...?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry!
It was a lot harder than I thought...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Is this opinion really necessary? Or maybe I should organize my thoughts a bit better before speaking...? Once my mind starts spinning in circles like that, it's all over.

I have an opinion. But it's not something I can say lightly.
It seems there are hurdles to clear
before I can actually put it into words...

In other words, does she still feel
too reserved around me—?

We talked about our dreams, and she shared her feelings about aiming for the center.
I never once felt a wall between us.
Considering everything up until now, this kind of distance might just be "normal" for her.
No matter how close she got with others, she might never have had the kind of conversation that takes a step further—one where you clash passionately.
In that case, the first thing to do is—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Things I like?
Um... Sweets, I guess.
I love sweet, fluffy whipped cream!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And then, a rug, perhaps?
Looking around for one at a general store, maybe.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
…………E-Excuse me...
Are you really sure this is okay?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it boring
just listening to me talk?"
choice_data_list: Oh, then it's my turn—listen to my story
Oh, then it's my turn—listen to what I have to say

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
!
Of course!

We talk a lot about each other,
including personal matters.

Things we like, things we hate,
funny stories, sad stories,
yesterday's dinner, places we want to visit, tomorrow's plans.
After spending several days like that, and then.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu! Trainer,
at that rate you won't be able to make your point properly.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Whisking in plenty of air,
keep a nice rhythm: tap, tap, tap—
Yes, exactly, you're doing great!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, hold on, I'm gonna go
check on the oven real quick!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that'd be a big help!

text_block_list.text:
Stepping down from the position of an instructor to stand on equal ground.
Having weaknesses supported by one another, and experiencing new things together.

Looking at the same scenery and sharing our thoughts.
Good, bad, neither, or uninterested.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I love baby's breath.
They're so small and adorable!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
what kind of flowers do you like?

And so,
once the hurdle inside her is lowered—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
How about increasing the load a bit more?
I know you're just being considerate of me, though.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Still, as expected, it's far from enough.
I need it in order to become stronger.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (Ah... thank goodness...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...H-Huh? Did I just—
choice_data_list: Pouring your feelings out like that—you're not scared of doing it, are you?
Pouring your feelings out isn't scary to you, is it?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I-It was completely unconscious! Huh?
Before I realized it, I had said it—I wonder why.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
When did you...? 
Maybe it's because you're my Trainer...
choice_data_list: Maybe that's how it was back then. But—

text_block_list.text: "Even without knowing everything about the other person, most people can listen attentively and take in their perspective."
choice_data_list: Even Dantsu Frame would say the same, right?
Even Dantsu Frame would say the same, wouldn't she?

text_block_list.text:
As long as you understand that,
even if it's not with me, you'll surely be able
to express your feelings honestly.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...—
I'm... surprised.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, oh.
I see, so that's how it was.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: So this is what it really means to pour all your feelings into something.

I took Dantsu Flame's feedback into account
immediately, dialing up her training regimen
to be one step harder.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I have to give the Kisaragi Sho everything I've got.
I must, I absolutely must...!
And on the day of the Kisaragi Sho.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I will definitely win...!!

Feeling a distinct change rising from deep within her,
the Kisaragi Sho gets underway!
